[SWS_DM_00570] Retrieving data for requested DataIdentifier
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04097
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), the
Diagnostic
Server instance
shall retrieve the mapped data for that DataIdentifier.
There are various ways how
DID
data retrieving is modeled. Among them are:
• received entire
DID
via ara::diag interface [SWS_DM_00601] or
